page_title: Dropshare - upload anything anywhere on macOS and iOS

sources.entry: Dropshare - File sharing tool for screenshots, screen recordings, and other files.

summary.name: Dropshare
summary.one_liner: Dropshare is a menu bar file-sharing app for macOS and iOS that uploads files, folders, screenshots and screen recordings to cloud drives, S3-compatible storage, or your own server.
use_cases: Upload screenshots and get a shareable link
Record screen as video or GIF and share it
Send files to your own S3 bucket or server
Keep personal and work files in separate cloud destinations
Encrypt files before sending to object storage
summary.what_it_does: Dropshare lives in the macOS menu bar and uploads files via drag and drop, keyboard shortcuts, the share menu, services, or Shortcuts automation. It supports 36+ storage integrations, including consumer cloud drives, S3-compatible object storage, image hosts, and protocols such as SFTP, FTP, SCP and WebDAV, and transfers go directly from the device to the configured provider. It includes screenshot capture with a built-in annotation tool, and screen recording as 24/60 FPS video or animated GIF with optional audio and webcam. An optional feature uses OpenAI's GPT-5 nano to suggest filenames for screenshots, with limited free daily use or your own API key. Upload history and preferences can sync across Apple devices via iCloud.
notable: Transfers go directly from device to the user's own storage provider, with no intermediate storage on the vendor's infrastructure
Optional client-side encryption before upload to object storage and protocol services
Built-in screenshot annotation and screen recording as GIF or video
Automatic AI-suggested screenshot filenames via OpenAI GPT-5 nano
caveats: Paid license after a 7-day free trial; one-off purchase price listed as 391 (including VAT, sold via Paddle)
AI filename feature has limited free daily usage unless you supply your own OpenAI API key
Not every storage provider is supported on every platform; see the availability matrix
Dropshare Cloud, a former storage option, was discontinued in late 2023
